heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 早~小舞

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_459
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……啊，小香奈、小绘梨，早——

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_461
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……？什么事？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_462
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……不是不需要我吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_463
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不要突然发出这么大声音啊！
吓我一跳

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_465
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……为什么要追过来？
你们已经有吉他手了吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_466
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 我又不是真的想玩乐队……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_467
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……无所谓吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_469
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
是因为虚荣心啦！
我只是想让大家觉得我很厉害而已！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_471
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……啊啊~
都是小灯的错哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_472
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 爽世同学，等等。我有话要说

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_473
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 爽世同学！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_474
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 直到你肯听我说话为止！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_475
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
爽世同学……呃！
这公寓是怎么回事……！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_476
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 诶~好厉害……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_477
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
诶~~~？
天花板好高！沙发好大！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_478
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
也太像豪华酒店了，生活感为零啊……
你该不会是一个人住吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_479
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
谢、谢谢。
这个香气……是初次见面的时候我们一起喝的茶呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_480
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
听说了哦。虽然很生气，
但却让我觉得，爽世同学也是人类呢~

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_481
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不仅是个两面派，谎话一个接一个，
还有着坏心眼的地方

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_482
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……你是个迷路的孩子

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_483
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
是小灯说的哦。
小爽世和我，都是迷路的孩子

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_484
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
小灯在等你。
就算你说不需要我，
我还是会在乐队里

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_485
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
是啊。
这不是我们组建的乐队嘛

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_486
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
哇……
好多观众啊……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_488
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 啊~好了好了。我这就连扩音器

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_489
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……谢谢大家！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_490
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 什么情况！？我完全不明白……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_491
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，你们在啊！
Rikki、小乐奈，你们来得真早呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_492
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
和我一起来的。她现在在前台，
爽世同学呢？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_493
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
这样啊……
我想她应该看见消息了……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_494
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 诶？怎么突然说这个

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_495
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊……
有兴致的时候会稍微弹一弹~

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_496
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 哈啊！？这是……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_497
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……你太不会道歉了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_498
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
但这样距离正式演出几乎没有准备时间哦？
怎么办？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_499
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我们的歌，
只有Rikki写的『碧天伴走』这一首吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_500
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 这样的话，其他能演奏的歌……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_501
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……等一下！
你们是不是忘记了更重要的事情！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_502
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
乐队名和演出服！！
还什么都没定呢！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_503
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 这次我绝对不会让步的！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_504
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我来做演出服！
今晚就想设计图！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_505
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……现在才发现？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_506
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 她应该没想过吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_507
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
如果不顽固的话，她也不至于宁愿和我们吵架，
也要找回爽世同学了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_508
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
她没有放弃乐队，也没有放弃爽世同学。
即使只剩下她自己

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_509
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 我们真是被小灯牵着鼻子走呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_510
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……那个。
我不打算喊你爽世同学了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_511
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我没有放弃！
所以Soyorin也不要放弃哦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_512
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不要放弃哦——！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_513
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
但是，乐队名已经想好了呀！
『ANON TOKYO』！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_514
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
为什么！？怎么想都只有这一个选项吧！
真是没品位！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_515
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 当然，我有认真思考哦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_516
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我把演出服的参考图传到手机里了~
看，这种怎么样？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_517
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 被固有观念框住可不好哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_518
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我觉得有各种各样的展示方法是好事！
我还是想引人注目！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_519
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
好啦好啦，坐吧。
这边沙发的视野也很好哦~

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_520
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 如果有什么不懂的，都可以问我哦？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_521
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
？好吃……？
诶？小乐奈，你在吃什么！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_522
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 现在就已经在吃饭了吗！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_523
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
哦哦~刚才的声音是不是很棒！？
这个效果器好像买对了！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_524
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
刚才我在乐器店看见的。
一下子就有来电的感觉了~

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_525
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……咦？
怎么感觉拨片的形状……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_526
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
诶诶，怎么办……
早知道就买备用的拨片了……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_527
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
这是小乐奈的拨片……？
你要借给我用吗？谢谢~！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_528
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，印着什么标识。
我看看……『SPACE』？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_530
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
好过分，我们只是在练习嘛！
那我来处理演出服，Rikki和Soyorin也来帮忙吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_531
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 诶？不是很可爱吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_532
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
明明是你们没品位！
对吧，Tomorin？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_533
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 是Rikki，Rikki啦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_534
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……话说，你们看外面！
夜景好漂亮！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_535
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
对了！大家一起拍照吧！
我创建了一个乐队专用的社交媒体账号，把照片发在上面！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_536
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
好啦好啦！
快点站好！Soyorin也快来！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_537
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我看看……糟糕，这什么啊？
只有我一个人拍得像模像样啊！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_538
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
诶？等一下，你们两个！
不重拍吗！？等等呀！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_539
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，Tomorin，你在这里啊。
今天在我家集合哦。走吧~

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_541
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
诶诶？
之前去见她的时候，她不是当我们不存在吗

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_542
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: Tomorin……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_543
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: Tomorin……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_544
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……距离和Soyorin她们集合，
还有一段时间吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_545
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
你看啊，Tomorin。
有好多企鹅在游泳哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_546
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 虽然是在水里，但看起来就像是飞在空中一样呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_547
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
还以为来到这里或许会让你打起精神，
看来在那件事之后好像有点难呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_548
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……这个，给Tomorin

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_549
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 之前你给了我很多，所以也送给你

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_550
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……我的心上就贴着哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_551
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
初中同学发现我的时候。
Tomorin就是在这里安慰我的吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_552
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
还有，在天台上的时候……
你说，一起迷路吧……那句话也戳中了我

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_553
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……还有

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_554
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
等等——！
我马上要说一句很棒的话，你听着！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_555
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……那个。
一辈子组乐队的事情

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_556
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 我也会努力试试的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_557
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
虽然一辈子很遥远，
但把许许多多的一瞬间叠加起来，或许就也没那么遥远

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_558
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
说实话，我没有自信，也可能会大吐苦水……
但只要在迷茫中前进就可以了吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_559
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……所以，演出我会加油的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_560
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……噗，啊哈哈！
Tomorin真可爱

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_561
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
等、等一下！
难道你是sumimi的初华——！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_562
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……啊！不好意思！
你现在是在休假吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_563
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
诶~！好温柔~！
我非常喜欢sumimi，是小初华的粉丝……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_564
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
诶！我之前跟你说过吧！
就是我们第一次一起去卡拉OK的时候！
那个双人组合……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_565
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……？你们俩以前就认识吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_566
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，对了！
我们在玩乐队，
如果可以的话，请关注一下我们的账号……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_567
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
什么，这是梦吗……？
话说，既然你和小初华认识，倒是告诉我呀~！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_568
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊——但是，你之前不知道小初华的事情呢。
那就没办法了啊……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_569
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
嗯？但是小初华……
知道Tomorin的名字吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_570
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 诶？那，为什么……？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_571
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 所以，帮我做演出服吧！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_572
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
话说，我一个人做五个人的演出服太难了吧？
你们要帮帮我啊~

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_573
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
基础服装已经送到了，
接下来只需要添加一些布料进行再加工！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_574
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不好！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_575
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊——Tomorin写完歌词很累，
还是让她睡一会比较好吧……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_576
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 现在Rikki正在根据歌词创作曲子

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_577
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
她说会在今天内完成，把曲子带过来，
等Rikki来了再把Tomorin叫醒吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_578
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不好吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_579
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，Rikki你总算来了。
曲子写好了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_580
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
那么，Rikki就做自己的演出服吧。
这是布料和线……还有什么来着？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_581
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
Soyorin可能不想起来。
她说她是不熬夜主义……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_582
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
小乐奈，衣服做得怎么样了……啊！
等等！为什么要打开吉他盒！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_583
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 啊，Tomorin醒了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_584
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……吉他用了多久才会变成这样？
到处都破破烂烂的……是古董吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_585
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
奶奶……
说起来，你给我拨片的时候也说了呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_586
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 米拉……什么？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_587
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……哪怕跌倒，哪怕迷茫，也要一辈子吗

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_588
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊……！
对呀，Tomorin！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_589
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
等一下！
我有好好保存着……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_590
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 找到了，就是这个！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_591
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
和Tomorin第一次去水族馆时的宣传单！
你还记得当时写了什么吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_592
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 没错！我们的乐队名！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_593
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 『迷路的孩子的乐队』！！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_594
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
新歌我们只合奏过一次啊！
我说~按那种感觉就行了吗！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_595
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我说，那个算是完成了吧？
刚才那个，算是完成新曲了吧~！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_596
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 那个，我们是『迷路的孩子的乐队』！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_597
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，不是迷路的孩子，
是迷路的孩子的乐队……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_598
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
哈啊……
居然直接说迷路的孩子……已经被省略了……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_599
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: Rikki不是也说『迷路的孩子的乐队』很好嘛！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_600
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
你说了~
因为我们的乐队，总是在迷路……诶！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_601
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
总是在迷路……
总是迷路？It's……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_602
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……！
It's my go！！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_603
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
It's my go呀！
It's my go！不得了，重大发现！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_604
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
对，没错！
不是非常棒吗！？
非常符合我们！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_605
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
哼哼。
看吧？把演出服做出来是正确的吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_606
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 诶，什、什么？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_607
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
等等，怎么了怎么了？
你想说什么呀~！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_608
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 啊，等等，小乐奈

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_609
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: Tomorin，不说点什么吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_610
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不是说这个啦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_611
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我是爱音！没有那么容易迷路啦。
地图也能看懂的！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_612
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
呵呵……那么，接下来。
Tomorin也自我介绍一下吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_613
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 唔唔~结束了~！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_614
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
Tomorin，你说了『MyGO』，
那个难道是，难道是！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_615
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
哈！？
开始之前，你不是还在质疑这是什么名字吗！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_616
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
既然这样，我想到了一个更好的！
在MyGO后面加上五个『！』……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_618
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
很不错吧！？
我觉得这样更有前进的感觉！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_619
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 诶——！这个绝对很棒的——！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_620
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
小乐奈！？
哇——别在这里睡啊！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_621
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊啊~真是的！
行了，把小乐奈带去休息室吧！
